si3_author_journal_year.answer: Xiao Lin et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023

si4_title.answer: Understanding the heterogeneity of dynamic functional connectivity patterns in first-episode drug naïve depression using normative models

dc1_datasets_using.detail: International Big-Data Center for Depression Research; a multi-site dataset collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China.
dc1_datasets_using.supporting_text: We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR).

answer.Healthy-comparison: statistical group comparison and validation of deviations

answer.FEDN-MDD: clinical research/patient group for mapping biological heterogeneity

dc2_datasets_purpose.detail: Healthy controls were divided into three independent groups (Healthy-ICA, Healthy-base, Healthy-comparison) to avoid data reuse bias across different analysis steps (ICA, normative modeling, and group comparison).
dc2_datasets_purpose.supporting_text: We divided the healthy controls into three groups to avoid reusing data in different steps of analysis which might lead to biased results. ... The data from the healthy-ICA group were only used to construct the brain networks ... The data from the healthy-base group were used to construct the sex-specific normative age model ... And the comparison was made between the healthy-comparison group and the FEDN-MDD group.

dc3_hc_n.detail: The study utilized a total of 832 healthy controls. 289 individuals (Healthy-base group) were specifically used to train/establish the normative models. The overall phase includes the Healthy-ICA (125), Healthy-base (289), and Healthy-comparison (418) groups.
dc3_hc_n.supporting_text: resulting in 274 FEDN-MDDs and 832 controls; 4) 125 healthy control individuals ... as a healthy-ICA group ... 5) Another 289 healthy control individuals ... as a healthy-base group ... to establish a normative model; 6) ... the rest 418 healthy control individuals ... as a healthy-comparison group

dc4_age_info.detail: Overall phase statistics were calculated as weighted mean and pooled SD from the three control subgroups (Healthy-ICA: N=125, 31.11±8.50; Healthy-base: N=289, 28.83±9.19; Healthy-comparison: N=418, 30.13±8.93). Min/Max values are inferred from the study's inclusion criteria (18-50 years).

dc5_sex_info.detail: Male counts were inferred by subtracting the reported female counts from the total N for each group. Overall female N = 71 (ICA) + 165 (base) + 242 (comparison) = 478. Overall male N = 832 - 478 = 354.
